title: Halton Arp's interacting galaxies with different redshifts

tellings.quote: So Heltonarp was an astronomer who was a super famous astronomer uh for a very long while who s who one day observed he he could see like he found couples of galaxies that were they looked like they were exchanging gas but uh if you looked at their red shifts which are indicators of distance they had completely different red shift

plain: A famous astronomer named Halton Arp is said to have found pairs of galaxies that looked as if they were swapping gas, yet had completely different redshifts, the shift in their light that astronomers use to judge distance. The astronomer Beatriz Villarroel tells Michels about Arp's work without naming a source. If the pairs really touch, redshift would not always tell how far away something is, which would shake a basic tool of astronomy.
